moments.text: National Archives logo, then a title card: 341.PBB.345, Source: 16mm RSK (P Copy).
Handwritten marks on the film leader (341 PBB 345) slide past, then blank cream leader.
Dark teal frames; a white striped shape crosses the bottom for about 4 frames at 7.5 s, then the picture goes almost black.
16 mm colour film of plain blue sky, a dark vertical stripe left of centre. Small pale dots flicker into view right of the stripe.
Clearest view: about six small pale dots, mostly in pairs, grouped right of the dark stripe.
The dots spread out and grow fainter against the blue.
The film turns very dark navy; at most a few faint pale dots can be made out.
Unrelated footage: close-up of a sewing machine, a hand pointing at the needle with a pointed stick, then fingers at the thread tension knob.
Blank cream film, a grey frame, then an End of Recording card.

notes: From 55.5 s the file is unrelated sewing-machine footage (stated in the official summary). 25-55 s is very underexposed.
